ESTABLISHED 1998 — SINGLE ORIGIN

Grown slowly.
Sealed at harvest.

A small house that buys one lot at a time, from growers we can name.

SCROLL TO PLAY
SKIP TO THE COLLECTION

THE HOUSE

We buy small,
and we buy once.

HARVEST BLOOM began with a single terrace of barberry in South Khorasan and a stubborn idea: that the best fruit is not the biggest, and that nothing should be added to it.

Every lot is bought whole from one grower, graded by hand on a lit table, and closed under nitrogen within days of picking. When a lot is gone, it is gone.

01
Named growers

One lot, one family, one terrace. Traceable to the row.

02
Hand-graded

Colour and calibre sorted on a lit table, never by machine alone.

03
Sealed at source

Nitrogen-flushed, light-barrier pouches closed within the week.

04
Nothing added

No sugar, no oil, no sulphur, no preservative. Ever.

THE COLLECTION

Six lots, bought whole.

Scroll to bring each lot forward, or choose one. Set a weight, and the price follows.
